data.title: Tokenized stock values on Ethereum, BNB Chain, ... | Pluang
data.description: Recent reports show tokenized stock values on Ethereum at $210.9 million, BNB Chain at $115.7 million, and Solana at $78.5 million. However, earlier data showed BNB Chain leading with $1.5 billion, Ethereum at $842.4 million, and Solana at $732.2 million. These discrepancies arise from differences in measurement scope and timing, making it unclear which network leads in tokenized stock value. Tokenized stocks represent blockchain-based exposure to traditional shares, distinct from native cryptocurrency values on these networks.
data.author: Tokenpost
